shared_elements: horizontal or curved band of pattern
justification: The clearest correspondence is the use of carved circular/oval motifs together with bands of repeated linear marks, especially a patterned horizontal zone on A and curved banding with vertical strokes on B. The biggest difference is that A is a crowded, horizontal panel of multiple small motifs, while B is a tall freestanding, largely symmetrical anthropomorphic-looking form dominated by one central figure-like composition.
